interface Box<T> { value: T }
interface NullableBox<T> { value: T | null }
type Left = Box<Right>;
type Right = Box<Left>['value'];
type Linked = NullableBox<Link>;
type Link = NullableBox<Linked>['value'];
type Optional = Box<OptionalLink> | null;
type OptionalLink = Box<Optional>['value'];
type Pair<T> = Box<PairLink<T>>;
type PairLink<T> = Box<Pair<T>>['value'];
type Keys = Box<Names>;
type Names = keyof Box<Keys>;
const node: Linked = { value: { value: null } };
const optional: Optional = { value: null };
const pair: Pair<string> | null = null;
const keys: Keys = { value: 'value' };
console.log(node.value?.value, optional.value, pair, keys.value);
interface Container<T extends { value: unknown }> { value: T }
type Constrained = Container<Constrained>;
const constrained: Constrained | null = null;
console.log(constrained);
